Title: FAO 2001 review of 25 years of community forestry
Supporting_Text: This follows the approach taken in FAO's 2001 review of 25 years of community forestry (Arnold, 2001).

Title: FAO 2012b definition of participatory forestry
Supporting_Text: FAO (2012b) has defined participatory forestry as: processes and mechanisms which enable people with a direct stake in forest resources to be part of decision-making in all aspects of forest management

Title: Forestry for local community development
Supporting_Text: The emergence, growth and evolution of community-based forestry as a formally recognizable modality of forest management can be traced back to the seminal paper Forestry for local community development (FAO, 1978).

Title: UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples
Supporting_Text: The United Nations (UN) Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (adopted by the UN in 2007) has given additional impetus to this movement.

Title: Forests, Trees and People Programme (FTPP)
Supporting_Text: FAO's Forests, Trees and People Programme (FTPP), with its regional hubs, was an important platform for developing and supporting networks to exchange information and share experiences.

Title: IPF/IFF Proposals for Action
Actors: Intergovernmental Panel on Forests (IPF), Intergovernmental Forum on Forests (IFF), United Nations Forum on Forests (UNFF)
Supporting_Text: The successor to IPF and IFF, the United Nations Forum on Forests (UNFF), incorporated the IPF/IFF Proposals for Action into its Multi-Year Programme of Work.

Title: UNFF Multi-Year Programme of Work 2007‑2015
Supporting_Text: Among the major themes of the 2007−2015 Programme of Work were community-based forest management; social development and indigenous and other local and forest‑dependent communities, including forest land tenure; and social and cultural aspects (UNFF, 2007).

Title: 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development
Supporting_Text: These initiatives include in particular the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the Sustainable Development Goals.

Title: Sustainable Development Goals
Supporting_Text: In September 2015 the United Nations adopted a set of 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) which provide an overarching policy framework to guide the world's development agenda until 2030 (UN, 2015).

Title: Forest Carbon Partnership Facility
Supporting_Text: The World Bank has developed a Forest Carbon Partnership Facility to prepare developing countries to participate in a carbon offset market for forestry projects.

Title: Lacey Act of 1900
Supporting_Text: The United States of America has added provisions to the Lacey Act of 1900 (which regulates trade in wildlife, fish and plants) to ban commerce in illegally sourced timber and wood products.

Title: Forest Law Enforcement, Governance and Trade (FLEGT) Action Plan
Supporting_Text: Concerns about the impact of illegal logging and associated trade led the European Union (EU) to adopt the Forest Law Enforcement, Governance and Trade (FLEGT) Action Plan in 2003.

Title: Voluntary Partnership Agreements (VPAs)
Supporting_Text: The EU's FLEGT process is centred on Voluntary Partnership Agreements (VPAs) between the EU and countries that produce or export timber.

Title: Forests and Livelihoods: Assessment, Research and Engagement (FLARE) network
Supporting_Text: In early 2015 IFRI announced the establishment of the Forests and Livelihoods: Assessment, Research and Engagement (FLARE) network, a community of practice with the aim of advancing the state of knowledge regarding forest‑based livelihoods.
